category_title: Students with right-to-left writing orientation and persistent transcription errors
scenario_title: Persistent transcription errors and letter identification hesitation
minimal_context: Farid is working one-on-one with his teacher to transcribe the letter 't' from lower-case to upper-case on a worksheet using an alphabet table.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Farid, please find the lower-case letter 't' on the alphabet table.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Hesitates, staring at the alphabet table without pointing to a letter.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep looking. Once you find it, copy the upper-case version of it into the blank space on your worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Finds the letter, but instead of copying the upper-case 'T', he replicates the lower-case form in the blank space.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: That is not correct. Look in the first line of the alphabet table again and write the upper-case letter in the box.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Locates the lower-case 't' on the table and again copies the lower-case 't' into the box.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Farid, please find the lower-case letter 't' on the alphabet table.

STUDENT: (Hesitates, staring at the alphabet table without pointing to a letter.)

TUTOR: Keep looking. Once you find it, copy the upper-case version of it into the blank space on your worksheet.

STUDENT: (Finds the letter, but instead of copying the upper-case 'T', he replicates the lower-case form in the blank space.)

TUTOR: That is not correct. Look in the first line of the alphabet table again and write the upper-case letter in the box.

STUDENT: (Locates the lower-case 't' on the table and again copies the lower-case 't' into the box.)

task.content: Transcribing the letter 't' from lower-case to upper-case on the worksheet

context.time_context: during the final movement of the lesson

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: prompted him to look in the first line of the alphabet table again after a previous failed attempt and teacher correction
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: located the lower-case 't' and again copied the lower-case 't' into the box
